<p align="center"><strong>Use the brass key on the attic door.</strong></p>


<p align="center">The key makes the false footprints fade. At the top of the stairs, the handle turns once from the other side and stops.</p>

<p align="center">The cat watches the orange ribbon. Elias keeps looking at your mouth, as though waiting for you to answer a question nobody has asked.</p>
